# Varshith Chennuru — AI Agentic Systems Engineer

> Varshith Chennuru is an AI/ML engineer who builds production LLM agent systems, RAG pipelines, and enterprise data platforms, and has hands-on foundation-model pretraining experience.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://varshithchennuru.dev/): Portfolio overview covering agentic AI, retrieval, foundation models, experience, projects, skills, and contact details.
- [Résumé (PDF)](https://varshithchennuru.dev/resume.pdf): Full CV with roles, dates, and technical stack.

## Core topics

- Agentic AI and multi-agent orchestration (LangChain, LangGraph), tool use, guardrails, and audit trails.
- Retrieval-augmented generation: embeddings, chunking, hybrid vector and keyword search, reranking, FAISS, and Qdrant.
- Large language model pretraining and fine-tuning, including an Indic-language LLM on a ~15–20 trillion token corpus.
- Cloud and MLOps on Azure, AWS, and GCP with Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD.
- Data engineering on a Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) architecture.
